title: Time Present and Time Past: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Temporally Evolving Document Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2608.08512v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Evolving documents, such as laws, tax codes, and software documentation, are amended, replaced, and sometimes reverted over time, so a question has different correct answers at different dates. In contrast to encyclopedic knowledge, where an old fact is simply overwritten, an amendment is itself an official text that states what it replaces and when it takes effect, and the earlier version stays correct for its validity period. The central challenge is therefore version resolution, that is, identifying the version in force on the queried date. Existing temporal QA datasets treat time only as an annotation, so version resolution stays untested. We present TIDE, an expert-verified benchmark of 3,050 QA pairs over 644 official customs instruments issued between 1969 and 2025 by the Government of Bangladesh, covering eight task types over deeply code-mixed documents that are heterogeneous in layout and dated in two calendars. translated_title: 时间现在与时间过去：大型语言模型在时间演变文档理解上的基准测试
translated_abstract: 演变的文档，如法律、税法及软件文档，会随时间被修订、替换，有时甚至被撤销，因此一个问题在不同日期会有不同的正确答案。与百科全书知识中旧事实被简单覆盖不同，修订本身是一份官方文本，它规定了所替换的内容及生效日期，而早期版本在其有效期内依然正确。核心挑战因此在于版本解析，即识别查询日期时有效的版本。现有时间问答数据集仅将时间视为注解，因此版本解析仍未得到测试。我们提出了TIDE，一个专家验证的基准测试，包含3050个问答对，覆盖孟加拉国政府于1969年至2025年间发布的644份官方海关文书，涉及八种任务类型，这些文档深度代码混合、布局异质，并采用两种历法标注日期。此外...
tldr: 本文提出了TIDE基准测试，用于评估大型语言模型在时间演变文档上的版本解析能力，这是首个关注此类挑战的专家验证数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TIDE, an expert-verified benchmark for evaluating large language models on version resolution in temporally evolving documents, marking the first dataset to address this challenge.
